canonicalDataStatus: non-executable planning artifact; canonical executable model is data/unary/h2o-standard-reference.json

pressure.interpretation: thermodynamic pressure of the pure substance

systemValidity.rationale: Deliberately reduced 1-atm OBGEL scope selected to include the familiar Ice Ih, liquid-water, and water-vapor regimes; the underlying IAPWS formulations have broader validity and the 250 K and 500 K bounds are not IAPWS validity limits.

pressureScope.pureVaporInterpretation: For the pure H2O vapor phase, the thermodynamic pressure is also p_H2O.
excludedContexts: independently specified total pressure and H2O partial pressure

sourceAuthorities.organization: International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam
sourceAuthorities.title: Revised Release on the IAPWS Formulation 1995 for the Thermodynamic Properties of Ordinary Water Substance for General and Scientific Use
sourceAuthorities.role: primary authority for liquid and vapor thermodynamics

sourceAuthorities.organization: International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam
sourceAuthorities.title: Revised Release on the Equation of State 2006 for H2O Ice Ih
sourceAuthorities.role: primary authority for Ice Ih thermodynamics

sourceAuthorities.organization: International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam
sourceAuthorities.title: Revised Release on the Pressure along the Melting and Sublimation Curves of Ordinary Water Substance

sourceAuthorities.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sourceAuthorities.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook: Water
sourceAuthorities.role: corroborating and convenient thermochemical data only; not the primary model authority
